$comment: Allowlist for scripts/check-env-coverage.ts. A var read by packages/api/src must
either appear in .env.production.example (the production contract) or be listed here.
optional   = REVIEWED. The call site was read and unset is genuinely correct: a dev/test
-only knob, a platform-injected var, a tuning constant with a literal default,
an opt-in flag that is off by default, or a fallback alias for a var that IS
declared. Each reason names the specific fallback so it can be challenged.
unreviewed = SEEDED FROM THE STATE OF THE REPO WHEN THIS GUARD LANDED, so it does not fail
on day one. These are NOT endorsed. Each is a var the API reads that is absent
from the production contract and whose absence plausibly changes product
behaviour silently. The script prints them loudly on every run and --strict
makes them fail. Work the list down: move an entry to `optional` with a
verified reason, or add the var to .env.production.example and set it.
Do not move an entry to `optional` without reading the call site.

optional.name: AI_CACHE_ENABLED
optional.reason: Opt-in response cache. gateway/factory.ts:209 requires the literal 'true'; unset = caching off, the current production behaviour.

optional.name: AI_COMPLETION_PROBE_TIMEOUT_MS
optional.reason: Readiness-probe timeout. gateway/readiness.ts:76 derives max(classify-intent deadline, 10s) when unset.

optional.name: AI_LIGHTWEIGHT_DEADLINE_MS
optional.reason: Tuning constant. config/ai-routing.ts:100 defaults to 1500ms.

optional.name: AI_STANDARD_DEADLINE_MS
optional.reason: Tuning constant. config/ai-routing.ts:101 defaults to 4000ms.

optional.name: AI_COMPLEX_DEADLINE_MS
optional.reason: Tuning constant. config/ai-routing.ts:102 defaults to 8000ms.

optional.name: AI_GATEWAY_STRICT_TENANT_ID
optional.reason: Tri-state override in gateway/gateway.ts:196; unset falls through to the built-in per-environment default.

optional.name: AI_MODEL_PRICING_JSON
optional.reason: Optional pricing override map. model-pricing.ts:144 returns {} when unset/blank, using the built-in table.

optional.name: AI_VISION_CAPABLE_MODELS
optional.reason: Optional comma-separated override. config/ai-routing.ts:288 falls back to the built-in list when unset.

optional.name: ALLOW_MISSING_CRITICAL_CONSTRAINTS
optional.reason: Migration escape hatch (db/migrate.ts:127). UNSET IS THE SAFE STATE - setting it skips the double-booking guard. Must never be in the production contract.

optional.name: API_PORT
optional.reason: Dev-only local URL builder (files/storage-provider.ts:292 defaultDevPublicUrl); falls back to PORT then '3000'.

optional.name: PORT
optional.reason: Injected by Railway at runtime; also the dev fallback in defaultDevPublicUrl. Never set by hand.

optional.name: AUTO_DEPROVISION_ON_CANCEL
optional.reason: Opt-in destructive behaviour (webhooks/routes.ts:1814 requires the literal 'true'). Unset = subscriptions cancel without deprovisioning, the current behaviour.

optional.name: CLERK_DEV_HMAC_TOKENS
optional.reason: Dev/QA-only HMAC token path (app.ts:4550). validateEnvSchema REFUSES it in production, so it must not appear in the production contract.

optional.name: CLIENT_WS_GATEWAY_ENABLED
optional.reason: Opt-in experiment (app.ts:4503 requires the literal 'true'); unset = the gateway is not installed.

optional.name: CUSTOMER_MMS_RATE_LIMIT
optional.reason: Tuning constant. customer-mms-intake.ts:72 defaults to 5.

optional.name: CUSTOMER_MMS_RATE_WINDOW_MS
optional.reason: Tuning constant. customer-mms-intake.ts:74 defaults to 1 hour.

optional.name: DB_HOST
optional.reason: Discrete-DSN dev fallback in db/pool.ts, used ONLY when DATABASE_URL is absent. Production sets DATABASE_URL (declared).

optional.name: DB_PORT
optional.reason: Discrete-DSN dev fallback in db/pool.ts (default 5432); unused when DATABASE_URL is set.

optional.name: DB_NAME
optional.reason: Discrete-DSN dev fallback in db/pool.ts; unused when DATABASE_URL is set.

optional.name: DB_USER
optional.reason: Discrete-DSN dev fallback in db/pool.ts; unused when DATABASE_URL is set.

optional.name: DB_PASSWORD
optional.reason: Discrete-DSN dev fallback in db/pool.ts; unused when DATABASE_URL is set.

optional.name: DB_SSL
optional.reason: db/pool.ts:13 disables TLS only on the literal 'false'; unset = TLS on, the safe default.

optional.name: DEV_AUTH_BYPASS
optional.reason: Rate-limit skip gated behind `isDev &&` (app.ts:856) - inert in production regardless of value.

optional.name: DISPATCH_FANOUT_ENABLED
optional.reason: Opt-in Redis fan-out (app.ts:4955 requires the literal 'true'); unset = in-process dispatch, the current behaviour.

optional.name: DRAIN_TIMEOUT_MS
optional.reason: Shutdown drain window. app.ts defaults to 25000ms.

optional.name: SHUTDOWN_FORCE_EXIT_MS
optional.reason: Force-exit backstop. index.ts:13 defaults to 30000ms.

optional.name: ELEVENLABS_VOICE_ID
optional.reason: tts-provider.ts:210 constructs ElevenLabsTtsProvider without a voice id when unset, using the provider account's default voice.

optional.name: FINANCING_ENABLED
optional.reason: Opt-in flag (config.ts:387). Unset AND no WISETACK_API_KEY = financing off; if either is set, config validation then REQUIRES WISETACK_WEBHOOK_SECRET, so this cannot half-enable.

optional.name: GIT_SHA
optional.reason: Sentry release tag (app.ts:751); falls back to RAILWAY_GIT_COMMIT_SHA, then undefined. Build metadata, not configuration.

optional.name: RAILWAY_GIT_COMMIT_SHA
optional.reason: Injected by Railway. Sentry release fallback (app.ts:751).

optional.name: LOG_LEVEL
optional.reason: app.ts:1657 selects 'debug' only on the literal 'debug'; unset = 'info'.

optional.name: NUM_REPLICAS
optional.reason: config.ts:430 - absent/unparseable/<=1 means single replica. When >1 WITHOUT REDIS_URL, config validation fails the boot, so a silent multi-replica degradation is impossible.

optional.name: OPENAI_API_KEY
optional.reason: Fallback alias only: transcription-providers.ts:502 uses `OPENAI_API_KEY || AI_PROVIDER_API_KEY`, and AI_PROVIDER_API_KEY is in the production contract.

optional.name: WHISPER_MODEL
optional.reason: transcription-providers.ts:506 defaults to 'whisper-1'.

optional.name: STRIPE_API_KEY
optional.reason: Fallback alias only: payment-link-provider.ts:129 uses `STRIPE_SECRET_KEY ?? STRIPE_API_KEY`, and STRIPE_SECRET_KEY is in the production contract.

optional.name: OVERDUE_SWEEP_INTERVAL_MS
optional.reason: Dev/QA sweep-cadence override (app.ts:6110); non-positive/unset = 1 hour.

optional.name: MONEY_RECONCILIATION_INTERVAL_MS
optional.reason: Money-invariant sweep cadence override (app.ts, money-reconciliation registration; also documented in .env.production.example). Unset = 6 hours; 0 disables the read-only sweep.

optional.name: PAYMENT_LINK_EXPIRY_HOURS
optional.reason: stripe-payment-link.ts:69 defaults to 24 hours on unset/unparseable.

optional.name: PROCESS_ROLE
optional.reason: config.ts:84 defaults to 'all' (web + workers in one process), which is correct for the single-service deploy. Only set when splitting into web/worker/voice services.

optional.name: RAG_RETRIEVAL_ENABLED
optional.reason: Opt-in retrieval adapter (app.ts:2224 requires the literal 'true'); unset = no retrieve adapter, the current behaviour.

optional.name: SHADOW_LLM_ENABLED
optional.reason: Opt-in shadow-traffic experiment (gateway/factory.ts:426 requires the literal 'true'); unset returns the primary gateway untouched.

optional.name: SHADOW_LLM_API_KEY
optional.reason: Only read after SHADOW_LLM_ENABLED==='true'; a missing key also short-circuits back to the primary gateway (factory.ts:428).

optional.name: SHADOW_LLM_BASE_URL
optional.reason: Only read on the opt-in shadow path (factory.ts:432).

optional.name: SHADOW_LLM_SAMPLING_RATE
optional.reason: Only read on the opt-in shadow path (factory.ts:433).

optional.name: STORAGE_ENABLED
optional.reason: Opt-OUT flag: config.ts:287 reads `!== 'false'`, so unset means storage is ENABLED. Setting it is how you turn storage off.

optional.name: TELEPHONY_ENABLED
optional.reason: Opt-OUT flag: config.ts:285 reads `!== 'false'`, so unset means telephony is ENABLED.

optional.name: TCPA_CONSENT_ENFORCEMENT
optional.reason: config.ts:57 defaults to 'off' - a DELIBERATE off-by-default documented in the schema comment (the DNC opt-out check still applies). Raising it to 'warn'/'block' is an explicit operator decision, not a missing value.

optional.name: TRAVEL_TIME_CACHE_TTL_SECONDS
optional.reason: Tuning constant. travel-time/google-provider.ts:4 defaults to 300s.

optional.name: TRAVEL_TIME_CACHE_MAX_ENTRIES
optional.reason: Tuning constant. travel-time/google-provider.ts:5 defaults to 1000 entries.

optional.name: TWILIO_BUSINESS_NAME
optional.reason: app.ts:3373 defaults to the generic 'our team' in SMS copy. Customer-visible but not a failure; set it if the generic phrasing is not wanted.

optional.name: VOICE_MIN_STT_CONFIDENCE
optional.reason: mediastream-adapter.ts:468 returns 0.5 when unset.

optional.name: VOICE_STREAM_TOKEN_MINTS_PER_MIN
optional.reason: Rate-limit tuning. routes/voice.ts:99 defaults to 30.

optional.name: VOICE_QUALITY_ALLOW_CASSETTE_FALLBACK
optional.reason: Voice-quality TEST harness only (ai/voice-quality/cassette-gateway.ts:130). Must stay unset - pr-checks.yml documents that setting it re-introduces the stale-response hazard.

optional.name: VOICE_QUALITY_CASSETTE_MODE
optional.reason: Voice-quality TEST harness only (cassette-gateway.ts:152); replay is the default.

optional.name: WEBHOOK_SIGNING_SECRET
optional.reason: Fallback alias only: voice-approval-pin.ts:42 uses `TENANT_ENCRYPTION_KEY ?? WEBHOOK_SIGNING_SECRET`, and TENANT_ENCRYPTION_KEY is in the production contract.

optional.name: WORKER_DEBUG_BOUNDED
optional.reason: Debug logging flag (queues/queue.ts:84); unset = quiet.

unreviewed.name: GOOGLE_MAPS_API_KEY
unreviewed.reason: UNSURE - almost certainly SHOULD be set. scheduling/travel-time/factory.ts:6 silently returns HaversineFallbackProvider when unset, so every travel-time estimate degrades to straight-line distance with no error. Named in the July 2026 Railway sweep.

unreviewed.name: SUPERVISOR_DEFAULT_PER_PROPOSAL_CAP_CENTS
unreviewed.reason: UNSURE - a per-proposal spend cap read at app.ts:6718. Named in the July 2026 sweep. Needs a product decision on the intended production value before it can be called optional.

unreviewed.name: SUPERVISOR_DEFAULT_DAILY_SPEND_CAP_CENTS
unreviewed.reason: UNSURE - a daily spend cap read at app.ts:6720. Named in the July 2026 sweep.

unreviewed.name: SUPERVISOR_DEFAULT_MAX_AUTO_APPROVALS_PER_HOUR
unreviewed.reason: UNSURE - an auto-approval rate cap read at app.ts:6722. Named in the July 2026 sweep.

unreviewed.name: SUPERVISOR_REVIEW_MODE
unreviewed.reason: UNSURE - selects the supervisor review lane (app.ts:6762). Whichever mode the unset default picks is currently undocumented in the production contract.

unreviewed.name: ONE_TAP_APPROVE_SECRET
unreviewed.reason: UNSURE - probably SHOULD be set. app.ts:1603 leaves the HMAC secret undefined in prod/staging when unset (dev gets a fixed dev secret), which disables one-tap approve rather than failing loudly.

unreviewed.name: PUBLIC_API_URL
unreviewed.reason: UNSURE - probably SHOULD be set. app.ts:1608 falls back to APP_PUBLIC_URL and then literally 'http://localhost:3000' when building one-tap approval links, in every environment.

unreviewed.name: APP_PUBLIC_URL
unreviewed.reason: UNSURE - second-choice public API base (app.ts:1150 / 1608) with the same localhost fallback as PUBLIC_API_URL. At least one of the two belongs in the contract.

unreviewed.name: PUBLIC_WEB_URL
unreviewed.reason: UNSURE - builds customer/owner links in escalation summaries (ai/agents/customer-calling/escalation-summary-builder.ts:55). WEB_URL is declared; whether these are aliases or distinct was not verified.

unreviewed.name: VOICE_PUBLIC_URL
unreviewed.reason: UNSURE - used when provisioning Twilio voice webhooks (workers/provision-twilio.ts:111). A wrong or absent value points inbound calls at the wrong host.

unreviewed.name: R2_BUCKET
unreviewed.reason: UNSURE - the contract declares R2_ACCOUNT_ID / R2_ACCESS_KEY_ID / R2_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY but NOT the bucket name (config.ts:32). Three of five R2 vars declared looks like an omission.

unreviewed.name: R2_PUBLIC_URL
unreviewed.reason: UNSURE - public base URL for stored objects (config.ts:33); undeclared alongside R2_BUCKET.

unreviewed.name: STORAGE_BUCKET
unreviewed.reason: UNSURE - feeds a readiness/health boolean at app.ts:3983. Its relationship to R2_BUCKET was not verified.

unreviewed.name: POSTHOG_API_KEY
unreviewed.reason: UNSURE - analytics/posthog.ts:90. Unset means no product analytics are emitted at all, silently.

unreviewed.name: POSTHOG_HOST
unreviewed.reason: UNSURE - analytics/posthog.ts:97; only meaningful alongside POSTHOG_API_KEY.

unreviewed.name: SUPPORT_EMAIL
unreviewed.reason: UNSURE - customer-facing support address used in outbound email (app.ts:1805). Whatever it falls back to is customer-visible.

unreviewed.name: SENDGRID_REPLY_TO_EMAIL
unreviewed.reason: UNSURE - reply-to on outbound email (app.ts:1805). SENDGRID_API_KEY and SENDGRID_FROM_EMAIL are declared; this one is not.

unreviewed.name: SENDGRID_FROM_NAME
unreviewed.reason: UNSURE - sender display name (notifications/delivery-provider-factory.ts:237); customer-visible, and its sibling SENDGRID_FROM_EMAIL IS declared.

unreviewed.name: QUICKBOOKS_CLIENT_ID
unreviewed.reason: UNSURE - QuickBooks OAuth credential (integrations/accounting/quickbooks-oauth.ts:141). Either accounting sync is not live in production, or four vars are missing.

unreviewed.name: QUICKBOOKS_CLIENT_SECRET
unreviewed.reason: UNSURE - QuickBooks OAuth credential (quickbooks-oauth.ts:142).

unreviewed.name: QUICKBOOKS_REDIRECT_URI
unreviewed.reason: UNSURE - QuickBooks OAuth redirect (quickbooks-oauth.ts:145).

unreviewed.name: QUICKBOOKS_ENVIRONMENT
unreviewed.reason: UNSURE - sandbox vs production selector (quickbooks-oauth.ts:135). Whichever the unset default is, it is undeclared.

unreviewed.name: VAPI_API_KEY
unreviewed.reason: UNSURE - Vapi voice-provider credential (integrations/vapi/client.ts:96). Either the integration is dormant or this is missing.

unreviewed.name: VAPI_BASE_URL
unreviewed.reason: UNSURE - Vapi API base (integrations/vapi/client.ts:112); only meaningful alongside VAPI_API_KEY.

unreviewed.name: WISETACK_API_KEY
unreviewed.reason: UNSURE - financing provider credential (financing/financing-provider.ts:159). Setting it also turns FINANCING_ENABLED on implicitly, so its absence is load-bearing.

unreviewed.name: WISETACK_API_BASE
unreviewed.reason: UNSURE - financing API base (financing-provider.ts:160); sandbox vs live is decided by whatever the unset default is.

unreviewed.name: WISETACK_WEBHOOK_SECRET
unreviewed.reason: UNSURE - financing webhook signature secret (app.ts:4725). Config validation requires it only once financing is enabled.

unreviewed.name: TWILIO_MESSAGING_SERVICE_SID
unreviewed.reason: UNSURE - Twilio Messaging Service (integrations/credentials.ts:100). Unset means sends fall back to a from-number, which changes deliverability and A2P registration behaviour.

unreviewed.name: EXPO_ACCESS_TOKEN
unreviewed.reason: UNSURE - passed to ExpoPushDeliveryProvider (app.ts:5324). Expo push works unauthenticated in some configurations; whether this deployment needs it was not verified.

unreviewed.name: CLERK_JWKS_URL
unreviewed.reason: UNSURE - optional in the config schema (config.ts:22) alongside the declared CLERK_SECRET_KEY / CLERK_PUBLISHABLE_KEY. The unset verification path was not traced.
